english: Mother, what shall I do on this day? You will drive the sheep to the pasture. Your sister will grind. What will father do? Father is ploughing the far field with the oxen. I will cook the meat. Shall I take the dog with me? Take him, and return home in the evening. Then will you give me meat? I will give you the best share. Are you glad now?

pie: h₁sń̥tyoḱlewes h₂énh₁mos stégos nékʷti déret. n̥bʰrós dṓm h₁n̥dó gʷm̥sḱéti. stégos h₁épi stéygʰoh₂ h₁íd-kʷe stégoh₂. bʰerHǵósyo moy lowbʰóm h₁opéye. kúdʰe lowbʰós h₁ésti? dréwi Hn̥dʰér ḱéyor. stégesos mē séngʷs. ne séngʷoh₂. pódh₁e moy ḱuh₁róh₁. bʰebʰóyh₂th₂e? pérkʷunos nos stégos mē kl̥h₂yéh₁t.
english: Of-True-Fame, the wind tore at the roof in the night. Rain is coming into the house. I will climb onto the roof and cover it. Hand me birch bark. Where is the bark? It is lying under the wood. Do not fall from the roof! I will not fall. My feet are strong. Are you afraid? May Perkʷunos not strike our roof!
